Job Description:



We are looking for a Lead AI/ML Engineer with 10+ years of experience, including 57 years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning and Generative AI, to lead the design and delivery of advanced AI solutions as Data Sceintist.
Key responsibilities & Hands-on experience with:
Can do Model Development (Core Responsibility)
Can build & refine ML models for use cases like anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, and RCA (root cause analysis).
Can perform data exploration, feature engineering, and statistical analysis to improve model accuracy and insights
Can design and evaluate LLM prompts, embeddings, and response quality for GenAI applications (RAG, copilots)
Can work on to build Agents, Multi-agents, Decision Flows
Can build scalable AI systems as GenAI / Engineer
Will Design and Implement data pipelines (ingestion ? preprocessing ? embeddings ? storage)
Will Generate design prompts for: Root cause explanation, Failure reasoning, Contextual insights
Will Develop APIs/microservices (FastAPI, backend services)
Will Handle vector DB setup & performance tuning
Will Integrate with Enterprise tools like QIR systems, model outputs, APIs,UI / dashboards
Will Manage data flow between systems



Required Skills & Qualifications



Lead the design, development, and deployment of ML models and Generative AI solutions
LLMs (OpenAI, Llama, Mistral, etc.)
LangChain / LlamaIndex
RAG architectures
AI Agents / multi-agent systems"
Build and optimize machine learning models (NLP, predictive, recommendation, anomaly detection) and ensure production-grade performance and scalability
Develop and implement AI agents and automation use cases such as copilots, RCA, and intelligent ticketing systems
Guide and mentor a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and delivery
Collaborate with data engineering and business teams to translate requirements into end-to-end AI solutions
Implement MLOps/LLMOps pipelines, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and lifecycle management
Strong proficiency in Python
Microservices architecture
Git, CI/CD pipelines
